screen.subject: 新製品の資料と価格改定について

lines.en: Hello, and welcome to Kamaru Business Japanese.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Today is lesson 11: 25 words — business keigo.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: First, let's listen to an email sent to a client.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Subject: Materials for the new product, and the price revision
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: To: Mr Yamada, Purchasing, Minato Trading
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Mr Yamada, Minato Trading
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Thank you for your continued business. This is Kimura from Sakura Electric.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Thank you for your call the other day.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: I am writing about what you said on the phone, that you would like materials on our new product.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Thank you very much for taking the trouble to ask.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: For details, please see the attached materials. We would also like to give you a sample.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: As for the price you asked about, material costs are rising, so prices are expected to go up from next month. Many manufacturers are in the same position.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: In the recent survey, we heard that sales at your company are going particularly well.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: We have also noted your request about the delivery date, and will do our best to keep to it as before.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: There is no change to the product warranty.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: We would also like to apologise again for the trouble caused by last month's late shipment.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Nakamura, who looks after your account, would also like to visit and greet you.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: We could also invite you to our meeting room for the discussion, so please let us know what suits you.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: We look forward to working with you.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Kimura, Sales, Sakura Electric
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Now let's go through today's words one by one. First: humble & respectful forms.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Respectful form of 言う, for what someone else says.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The department manager said so.
lines.name: 例文

lines.en: Humble form of 知る (to know) and 思う (to think).
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: I'm well aware of that matter.
lines.name: 例文

lines.en: Humble form of 言う, also used to give your name.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: How do you do. My name is Kimura.
lines.name: 例文

segments.meaning: to be (very polite → ございます)

lines.en: A very polite way to say ある, used as ございます.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The restrooms are on the second floor.
lines.name: 例文

lines.en: Humble form of あげる (to give).
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: We gave the customers a commemorative gift.
lines.name: 例文

lines.en: Polite form of 呼ぶ (to call), as in お呼びします.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Please wait until we call your name.
lines.name: 例文

segments.meaning: help, care (お世話になっております)

lines.en: A polite way to talk about looking after someone.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Thank you for your continued support.
lines.name: 例文

segments.meaning: knowing, agreeing (承知いたしました = certainly)

lines.en: Understanding and accepting what someone says.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Understood regarding your request.
lines.name: 例文

lines.en: Next: polite expressions.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: A respectful word for the other company, mainly in writing.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: We wish your company continued success.
lines.name: 例文

lines.en: A respectful word for the other company, mainly in speech.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: I'd like to ask about your company's products.
lines.name: 例文

lines.en: The polite way to say 電話 (phone call).
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Thank you for calling.
lines.name: 例文

lines.en: The polite way to say 連絡 (contact).
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: We'll let you know the result by email.
lines.name: 例文

lines.en: The polite way to say 確認 (check).
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Please check the attached materials.
lines.name: 例文

lines.en: The polite way to say 質問 (question).
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Feel free to ask if you have any questions.
lines.name: 例文

segments.meaning: in any case; kindly (なにぶんよろしく)

lines.en: Said when asking a favour, meaning "kindly".
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: We kindly ask for your support.
lines.name: 例文

segments.meaning: go out of one's way, take the trouble

lines.en: Going to special trouble.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Thank you for taking the trouble to come in the rain.
lines.name: 例文

lines.en: Feeling grateful.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: We're grateful for everyone's cooperation.
lines.name: 例文

lines.en: Last: trade words.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Formally apologising for your own fault.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The company apologised to the customer.
lines.name: 例文

lines.en: The money something costs.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The company pays for the trip.
lines.name: 例文

lines.en: A rise in price.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Vegetable prices keep rising.
lines.name: 例文

lines.en: How well a product is selling.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The new product is selling very well.
lines.name: 例文

lines.en: The deadline for delivering goods.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: We'll meet the delivery deadline.
lines.name: 例文

lines.en: A set of questions to collect opinions.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: We asked customers to fill in a survey.
lines.name: 例文

lines.en: A company that makes products.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: This computer is made by a Japanese manufacturer.
lines.name: 例文

lines.en: Protecting someone from loss.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: This insurance protects your livelihood if you fall ill.
lines.name: 例文

lines.en: Finally, let's check with a quiz. Choose the answer from 1 to 4.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Question 1. Which word goes in the brackets?
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The answer is 2: おっしゃいました. 申しました is humble, so not for your manager.
lines.name: ナレーター

segments.promptEn: Which word respectfully refers to the other company in writing?

lines.en: Question 2. Which word respectfully refers to the other company in writing?
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The answer is 3: 貴社. In speech, use 御社.
lines.name: ナレーター

segments.promptEn: How do you do. My name ___ Kimura.

lines.en: Question 3. Which word goes in the brackets?
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The answer is 1: 申します.
lines.name: ナレーター

segments.promptEn: What is the deadline for delivering goods?

lines.en: Question 4. What is the deadline for delivering goods called?
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The answer is 4: 納期.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Question 5. Which word goes in the brackets?
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The answer is 2: 承知, understood.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Today we studied 25 words: business keigo.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Review them again in the app's word list.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Good work today. See you in the next lesson.
lines.name: ナレーター
